This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
## Library the lpSolveAPI
library(lpSolveAPI)

## Initially create an lp file. Leaving code in file for reference
## write.lp(lp.model, "Assignment2.lp", type = "lp")

##Read the lp file containing the model parameters
Lp.Model <- read.lp("Assignment2.lp")

## Describe the lp model
Lp.Model

## Solve the lp model
solve(Lp.Model)

## get the object formula amount
## This case is maximizing profit
Profit <- get.objective(Lp.Model)
## Profit projected to be $694,620

## Get the variable amounts
LP.Vars <- get.variables(Lp.Model)

## Find the constraint values
LP.Cons <- get.constraints(Lp.Model)
```
After running the lp model the max profit the model calculated is $694,620.00 with a 92 percent capacity percent from each of the 3 plants. The specs relating to the exact production are below.

```{r}
## Create production table
production_table <- data.frame(
  Product = c("Large", "Medium", "Small", "Total"),
  Plant_1 = c(LP.Vars[1], LP.Vars[4], LP.Vars[7],
              LP.Vars[1] + LP.Vars[4] + LP.Vars[7]),
  
  Plant_2 = c(LP.Vars[2], LP.Vars[5], LP.Vars[8],
              LP.Vars[2] + LP.Vars[5] + LP.Vars[8]),
  
  Plant_3 = c(LP.Vars[3], LP.Vars[6], LP.Vars[9],
              LP.Vars[3] + LP.Vars[6] + LP.Vars[9]),
  
  Total = c(
    LP.Vars[1] + LP.Vars[2] + LP.Vars[3],
    LP.Vars[4] + LP.Vars[5] + LP.Vars[6],
    LP.Vars[7] + LP.Vars[8] + LP.Vars[9],
    sum(LP.Vars[1:9])),
  
  Profit_per_unit = c(420, 360, 300, NA),
  
  Profit = c(532 * 420, 853 * 360, 547 * 300, 694620)
)


production_table
```
